author: The Pandorga contributors
description: Pandorga is a publishing platform: Jekyll shell, browser content runtime, JSON export pipeline, and Studio editor. Sites declare pages in a registry; the gem supplies templates, gates, and the pandorga CLI.

author: JetRockets
description: CI decides whether a pull request needs a browser run and takes back reviewer requests until an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) has exercised the change in a browser and published what it observed. One command sets a project up.
